name: The Wheelwrights' Midway
prompt: Open a giant Ferris wheel workshop beside the ride. Mechanics fit a painted passenger car to the lowest spoke while finished cabins climb past the striped workshop roof.

name: The Giant's Marble Run
prompt: Thread an elevated timber marble course over a fairground midway. Children release bright wooden balls at the top, and attendants retrieve them from enormous brass catch bowls.

name: A Fair in the Looking Glass
prompt: Set a crooked row of mirror pavilions opposite a carousel. Curved mirrors stretch the carousel animals into long coloured stripes while visitors compare their reflections.

name: The Umbrella Waltz
prompt: Suspend enormous turning parasols from a fairground spindle. Each shelters a swinging bench; show a departing rider and an attendant winding the spindle at ground level.

name: A Queue That Plays Music
prompt: Fold the waiting line around an organ-powered swing ride. Guests step on hinged boards linked to pipes while the organist turns to hear the tune the queue has made.
